name: Lmap
description: LMAP (Large-Scale Measurement of Broadband Performance) platforms

rfc7536.title: Large-Scale Broadband Measurement Use Cases
rfc7536.abstract: Measuring broadband performance on a large scale is important for network diagnostics by providers and users, as well as for public policy.  Understanding the various scenarios and users of measuring broadband performance is essential to development of the Large-scale Measurement of Broadband Performance (LMAP) framework, information model, and protocol.  This document details two use cases that can assist in developing that framework.  The details of the measurement metrics themselves are beyond the scope of this document.

rfc7594.title: A Framework for Large-Scale Measurement of Broadband Performance (LMAP)
rfc7594.abstract: Measuring broadband service on a large scale requires a description of the logical architecture and standardisation of the key protocols that coordinate interactions between the components.  This document presents an overall framework for large-scale measurements.  It also defines terminology for LMAP (Large-Scale Measurement of Broadband Performance).

rfc8193.title: Information Model for Large-Scale Measurement Platforms (LMAPs)
rfc8193.abstract: This Information Model applies to the Measurement Agent within an LMAP framework.  As such, it outlines the information that is configured or preconfigured on the Measurement Agent or exists in communications with a Controller or Collector within an LMAP framework.  The purpose of such an Information Model is to provide a protocol- and device-independent view of the Measurement Agent that can be implemented via one or more Control and Report Protocols.

rfc8194.title: A YANG Data Model for LMAP Measurement Agents
rfc8194.abstract: This document defines a data model for Large-Scale Measurement Platforms (LMAPs).  The data model is defined using the YANG data modeling language.
